notes.title: 【Lovely Games】July Event! The third part of the YUME series is coming soon
notes.content:
Go to this page to comment!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2464120/view/3646275572498453990
YUME 3:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464120/YUME_3/
And everyone can support you business games~
Joy Life:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497280/Joy_Life/

[h3]Say in front[/h3]
[b] Regarding the YUME series, we have also received feedback from many players, related to the fluency of the game experience, or some bugs, and the completion of character design...
So we made a major decision before the third part is about to hit. While increasing the number of CGs and lowering the price, the gameplay will be simplified. It will no longer be the past exploration and decryption mode, and the dubbing and small theater performances will still be retained. Hope to give back Everyone loves it, and please believe that we are still working hard.
If you like the YUME series, don't miss it!
[/b]
[h3]Participation method[/h3]
You need to pay attention to the new game and add it to the wish list, and then comment on any game from [Lovely Games Studio] you want (Note: The new game will be released after the first release, please wait patiently)

[h3]Number of winners[/h3]
10 digits

[h3]Event time[/h3]
2023.7.11-2023.7.21
(This event will be issued at the same time as the prizes for the June event)
